name: STL Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: STL Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells lithium-ion power batteries for electric light vehicles, gardening and hand-held power tools, and energy storage system applications in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. It also provides customized solutions, including lithium-ion battery pack certification, structural and circuit design, safety and management certification, and battery pack manufacturing and shipping for power tools, energy storage/battery backup system, light electric vehicles, and other products. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
